components.heading: Validity.
components.text: Should any section or provision of these zoning regulations be determined to be unconstitutional or invalid, the same shall not affect the validity of the regulations as a whole or any part thereof other than the part so determined to be unconstitutional. (Code 1995 § 48-1.12.)
